card.name: Ingestion wording in overdose passages
card.fires_on: Words about swallowing a substance, such as "been", "ingested" and "ingestion", in overdose-treatment text. It also fires on a few unrelated words such as the period in "U.S.".

modes.label: Ingestion in overdose text
modes.description: The word ingestion or ingested, or the verb just before it, in overdose management passages.

modes.description: Occasional unrelated words, such as the period in an abbreviation or the word backup.
